name: COSCO SHIPPING International (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd.
summary: COSCO SHIPPING International (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, provides shipping services in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and internationally. It operates through Coatings; Marine Equipment and Spare Parts; Ship Trading Agency; Insurance Brokerage; Intelligent Shipping Services; and General Trading segments.
